title: QuoteFirst
description: Get dollar quotes from 200+ LLMs before any work runs; accept, execute, and verify quality.
summary: Get dollar quotes from 200+ LLMs before any work runs; accept, execute, and verify quality.
offersHint: Get dollar quotes from 200+ LLMs before any work runs; accept, execute, and verify quality. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://quotefirst.ai/api/mcp · Requires headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token using your QuoteFirst API key (create one in Settings at quotefirst.ai). Format: Bearer qf_your_key

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: Bearer token using your QuoteFirst API key (create one in Settings at quotefirst.ai). Format: Bearer qf_your_key

toolsPreview.name: quote
toolsPreview.description: Submit a task description and receive dollar quotes from multiple frontier AI models before any work is done. Returns the request id, quotes with prices in cents, and a recommendation.

toolsPreview.name: accept
toolsPreview.description: Accept one quote on a request. The chosen model executes the task. Poll get_deliverable for the result.

toolsPreview.name: get_deliverable
toolsPreview.description: Get the status and deliverable of a request. Status: quoting, quoted, executing, completed, failed.

toolsPreview.name: rerun
toolsPreview.description: Quality guarantee: re-run a completed request once for free if its deliverable scored below 70/100 on the automated quality check. Produces a fresh deliverable with the same accepted quote.

toolsPreview.name: spend
toolsPreview.description: Get your QuoteFirst spend this month in cents, total and broken down by model.

toolsPreview.name: estimate_cost
toolsPreview.description: Deterministic cost estimate across all models for a task, without using a quote from your allowance. Optionally pass expected_output_words.
